bonuses.name: Informants
bonuses.text: Before the first battle round, each fighter in your warband can make a free action.

bonuses.name: Calling in a debt
bonuses.text: You may recruit a `HIRED SWORD` without paying its listed recruitment fee.

bonuses.name: Saboteurs
bonuses.text: Select one fighter in the enemy warband without the `LEADER` keyword. That fighter misses the battle.

bonuses.name: Bounty
bonuses.text: When collecting income in the aftermath sequence, you may consider your standing to be one level higher.
